## Closed as a duplicate of objectui#10654 — one family, folded into its closure card

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T15:42Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, objectui#10654, and objectui `origin/main`.

Same file, same axis-layout mechanism: `AdvancedChartImpl`'s `horizontal-bar` branch does not lay out the declared axis keys. The current gate folds same-family findings into one closure card (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20110), and objectui#10654 is that card for the axis family objectui#10587 opened. It now carries this card's two rows (the `xAxis.title` never drawn, and the `yAxis` title drawn rotated beside the category ticks) with its measurement, at `priority:p2`. Neither card was claimed when the fold was made; objectui#10587 itself is in flight and was not touched.
